definitions.gloss: in short, in other words, basically
definitions.explanation: Used to summarize or rephrase what has been said in a simpler or more direct way.

examples.japanese: {要|よう}するに、{彼|かれ}は{来|こ}ないということだ。
{要|よう}するに、お{金|かね}が{足|た}りないんです。
examples.english: Basically, we don't have enough money.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{説明|せつめい}だったけど、{要|よう}するに{何|なに}が{言|い}いたいの？
examples.english: That was a long explanation, but in short, what are you trying to say?

notes:
USAGE: {要|よう}するに is used at the beginning of a sentence to introduce a summary or the main point of what was previously said. It's useful for cutting through complexity.

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・つまり - in other words, that is to say
・{結局|けっきょく} - after all, in the end
・{簡単|かんたん}に{言|い}えば - to put it simply
